According to experiments, ADMM is practically inapplicable to NA-constrained multi-scenario MILPs.
First of all, it needs to tune a $\rho$, which by itself is a problem
Second, it cannot directly furnish a valid dual bound. If we use heuristic method to reshape its dual vectors,
We may derive a valid dual bound, but it can be quite weak, e.g. it can be negative... so it's worse than natural LP bound.
Third, it cannot directly recover primal feasible solutions: the residual may be reduced to e.g. 0.001 and then cannot go down further.
